source.title: Newry Telegraph, 27 April 1933, p. 5 ("Local Government Nominations: Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council")
source.publisher: Newry Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text, labels checked against the page image where the OCR was unclear; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1933: only eight members were nominated and all were returned unopposed; in the other 21 divisions no nomination was received and the old members were automatically re-elected (not named in the report read). Returned unopposed.
